description: We are a multidisciplinary team of developers and researchers who believe that the best way to understand the cosmos is to step directly into the mission control seat. Combining technical craftsmanship in Unity and C#, we set out to bridge the gap between complex aerospace science and engaging, accessible gameplay. Just like a real lunar mission, MOONIES was brought to life by a dedicated crew united by a shared passion for space exploration, interactive storytelling and science education.
